digest.component_or_area: plan-review batch runner and pass-1 LLM execution
propositions: Pass-1 and prerequisite runner calls emit per-call usage dicts that are currently discarded, preventing per-criterion request counts and token totals from reaching batch outputs and coverage metrics.

The three pass functions (pass1_chunk, pass1_container, pass1_isf) must change return type to (findings, usage) pairs threaded through sizing.pass1_with_ladder, container fan-out, and all external callers (eval_solver, criterion_preview, fidelity_spot_eval) in a single atomic change.

Multi-criterion chunks must divide token fields equally across covered criteria while counting llm_calls and requests in full per criterion; ladder retry attempts each contribute a call record; raising attempts and checkpoint-served chunks contribute nothing.
BatchRunResult.outputs must carry _usage with per_call records, per_criterion attribution map, and aggregate totals; sidecar payload gains coverage.usage = {per_call, per_criterion}.
run_focused_finder must return (records, findings, usage) where usage sums all internal runner.run calls, and ProductionBatchRunner must merge its usage into batch output before emitting.
